configurations._comment: Attach-only. `next dev` refuses to start a second server for the same project directory (it holds a lock in .next/dev), so autoPort cannot rescue a session when another one already has the app running. Use this to attach to that server instead of killing it; use 'cirqle-app' when nothing is running yet.
configurations.name: cirqle-app-attach

configurations._comment: The hotfix/cashbook-embed-hints worktree at ../cirqle-app-hotfix, on its own port so it runs beside the main tree. Webpack, because its node_modules is a symlink to the main tree and Turbopack refuses symlinks that leave the project root.
configurations.name: cirqle-app-hotfix
